business.text: We are engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium gravity die castings and assemblies, serving domestic and international customers in United States of America (USA) and Germany across the Automotive, Power Generation, General Engineering, Railway & Marine, and Valve & Pump sectors. With core capabilities spanning process simulation, tool and die development, gravity die casting, heat treatment, precision CNC machining, and secondary finishing processes, our Company offers a fully integrated, single-source manufacturing solution for aluminium die-cast components.

emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Best Cast It Limited
emails.text:
Dear Mr. Mohit Baid and Ms. Heena Parwani,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Best Cast It Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 28, 2026 has been filed with NSE (Emerge) for listing on NSE Emerge.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON BEST CAST IT
Best Cast It is engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium gravity die castings and assemblies, serving domestic and international customers in United States of America and Germany across the Automotive, Power Generation. We have studied the DRHP closely and the business fits well with our investment focus.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO round: Should the Company consider a pre-IPO placement ahead of the RHP, we would be keen to participate.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book of the SME IPO.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Best Cast It (Mr. Kabirdass Murali and Mr. Shreyas M Kabirdass) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
SEBI Reg. No.: IN/AIF3/25-26/2108

This email is for introduction purposes only and does not constitute an offer, solicitation or commitment to invest. Any investment is subject to the Fund's due diligence, investment committee approval and applicable SEBI regulations. To stop receiving emails from us, reply with “unsubscribe”.
